steps.what: Read existing clinical information before considering diagnostic procedures
Determine whether to recommend diagnostic procedures through the actual authorised clinical route
Discuss the recommended procedures and arrangement route with the patient
Prepare the complete diagnostic procedures request with actual rationale and patient details
Review the actual diagnostic procedures request and authorise the final clinical referral
inputs: actual clinical authority and provider requirements

steps.what: Send only the authorised diagnostic procedures request to the verified provider

tasks.design: Use native patient-record views and referral fields in {OTHER} to reduce navigation and repeated request details. The chiropractor retains assessment and patient discussion, and the actual authorised requesting clinician reviews the complete request before its exact transmission to the provider.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant history and factual patient and provider fields are repeatedly found and copied into a diagnostic request.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record-linked referral forms remove repeated clerical work without selecting a test or conferring ordering authority.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriateness and the permitted referral route depend on the clinical case, professional scope and jurisdiction.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when further assessment is needed and explain the actual route to the patient.

ambition.what: Clinical recommendations and ordering authority remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient-linked referral forms can reduce repeated fields while clinical recommendations and actual ordering authority remain with qualified people.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing patient record and authorised diagnostic-request exchange. The scenario uses an actual separate requesting clinician under the provider's established referral route; no ordering right is inferred from the occupation title.

Registration and previous treating clinicians produce existing identity and history. The chiropractor checks them in s1 and captures the actual rationale and request in s4. No clean clinical intake or automatic diagnosis is supplied free.

s1 removes3.8 units of navigation, retaining15.2 for reading. s4 removes nine units of repeated identity, provider and form fields, retaining16 for actual rationale, procedure details and checks. Native reuse already active earns no new saving.

s5 is the actual clinical referral review after the complete request exists, not author self-approval of notes. The exact patient, request, rationale, attachments and provider destination are bound to s6; edits void that authority. The current tiny send and ordinary ungated draft save earn no saving.
Provider appointment allocation and the procedure itself occur after the request and are not removed or assigned a saving. Applicable professional scope and the actual route require confirmation.
unknowns: Actual referral authority and provider route
research_questions: Can the final request preserve the actual clinical rationale without assuming an ordering permission?

steps.what: Read the patient's existing supports history and relevant care information
Assess whether supports are appropriate and suggest the actual option to the patient
Apply the necessary straps, tapes, bandages or braces and check their actual fit
Explain the actual supports use and check the patient's understanding
Write the actual supports applied, fit observations and advice in the care record
Save the actual supports note in the existing care record

tasks.design: Use the existing support-history view and a short actual-treatment field set in the care record {OTHER}. The chiropractor assesses, applies and checks the support and explains its use; the record reflects the actual application rather than a planned product.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding prior support information and repeated note headings surround physical care.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and fields remove a little clerical work without changing support choice or application.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability, fit and patient understanding require direct assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Notice discomfort or poor fit and adapt the actual application and explanation.

ambition.what: Support assessment and application remain clinical work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native history and note fields can slightly reduce support-treatment paperwork while assessment, fitting and instruction remain direct clinical work.

assumptions: OTHER means the care record, clinical setting and physical support materials. Boundary includes the real treatment note used in ongoing care, not an invented device order or separate advice report.

Prior clinicians supply existing history. The chiropractor makes the actual choice, applies and checks the support and captures its actual type, application and observations in s5. No sensor or product-selection model supplies missing facts.

s1 removes one navigation unit, retaining nine for reading. s5 removes0.7 units of repeated note headings, retaining13.3 for actual application detail and checks. All75 assessment, application and explanation units remain.
Ordinary one-unit same-record save is fully retained and ungated. Native configuration already used earns no new saving, and no clinical recommendation is generated automatically.
unknowns: Current support-history view and treatment-note fields
research_questions: Can the note distinguish the actual support applied from an earlier suggestion?
